//: Deploy config for the J Voice Firebase project (jvoice-b4b2e).
This lives at the repo root, not in firebase/, because a deploy now spans
both folders: the rules come from firebase/ and the site from
'J Voice web/dist'. Firebase refuses a 'public' path outside the config's
own directory, so the config has to sit above both.
Hosting serves the Vite build of 'J Voice web'. That single bundle is both
halves of the site: '/' is the public Telugu reader and the staff sign-in
sits at the foot of it, '/console' and below are staff-only. Because the
routing is client-side, every unknown path rewrites to index.html - without
that, a hard refresh on /console returns a 404 from Hosting before React
Run `npm run build` in 'J Voice web' before deploying - a stale dist ships
functions: the FCM push relay in firebase/functions (see its index.js).
Needs the Blaze plan; `firebase deploy --only functions` deploys it alone.

headers.//: Hashed filenames, so the bundle is immutable and cacheable for a year.
index.html must never be cached, or a deploy is invisible to returning visitors.
